content.title: About
content.content: 100% pomegranate juice is made from ripe pomegranates without added sugar, preservatives or flavorings. It has a vivid red color, a characteristic sweet‑tart taste and a rich aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The pomegranate is a symbol of fertility and abundance in many cultures.
Pomegranate juice contains over 200 bioactive compounds, including polyphenols and anthocyanins.
In ancient Egypt, pomegranates were used in rituals and as a longevity aid.
Pomegranate juice is widely used in Middle Eastern cuisine for marinades, sauces and desserts.
When not heat‑treated, the juice retains most of its vitamins and minerals.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Polyphenols, anthocyanins and vitamin C help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Flavonoids improve endothelial function and may help lower blood pressure.

items.title: Contains vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K is essential for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium aids fluid balance and supports heart function.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Vitamin C and other phytochemicals strengthen the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to pomegranate.

items.title: High natural sugar content
items.content: Even without added sugar, the natural sugars can be a concern for people with diabetes.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Pomegranate juice can increase the effect of certain medications, such as statins.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice on its own, add it to smoothies, cocktails, sauces or marinades. For a milder taste, dilute with water or another fruit juice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C in a sealed container. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Freezing may cause crystallisation but the flavor remains intact.
